Theorem
[Hamilton, 3-manifolds with positive Ricci curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0385 1. appD:D.7\group Ricci Flow Convergence

If $(\mathcal M^3,g_0)$ is closed and has positive Ricci curvature, its normalized Ricci flow exists for all $t\geq 0$ and converges exponentially in every $C^m$ norm to a smooth metric of constant positive sectional curvature.
